topics.title: bullets.nvim: Visual promote and demote renumber only the selected lines
topics.note: lua/modules/plugins/lang.lua runs :RenumberList after BulletDemoteVisual and BulletPromoteVisual. Once fixed: map the two x-mode indent keys back to the plugin's bullets-demote and bullets-promote Plug mappings, then check the Visual cases (g.md, h.md, g2.md, h2.md) in tests/runtime_stage2_first_idle_spec.lua.

topics.title: sops.nvim: saving a SOPS file fires neither BufWritePre nor BufWritePost (C35)
topics.note: No workaround: SOPS files are not formatted on save. Once fixed: add a save test with a fake sops binary on PATH (no real keys) and confirm the ConformAcwrite handler in lua/modules/configs/completion/conform.lua formats the plaintext without leaving a .conform.* file.

topics.title: blink.cmp: accept edits the current buffer instead of the one the completion started in (C01)
topics.note: No workaround, by decision. The maintainer linked it to his open PR 2022, also watched here. Once fixed: rerun the C01 repro from the upstream issue. The maintainer asks for human-written issue and PR text, so write any reply there yourself.

topics.title: lazydev.nvim: each lua_ls restart adds another buffer listener (C11)
topics.note: lua/modules/configs/completion/lazydev.lua wraps lazydev's on_attach (commit 8580e0a). Once fixed: drop the wrapper and keep the test 'restarting lua_ls does not make lazydev scan each edit once more' in tests/plugin_dependencies_spec.lua. The repo's stale bot closes issues 7 days after marking them stale; comment if it is about to close.

topics.title: nvim-ts-autotag: changing the filetype keeps the first filetype's setup (C17)
topics.note: No workaround. The repo's stale bot marks issues after 60 quiet days and closes them 7 days later; the fix diff is in the issue body if a PR is needed. Once fixed: rerun the repro from the issue with the real config.

topics.title: Neovim 0.12: lsp.enable starts a client for a wiped buffer (Invalid buffer id)
topics.note: Fixed on master by Neovim PR 42488 but not backported to release-0.12; no workaround. Once a release with the fix is installed: run tests/plugin_dependencies_spec.lua and check that 'vim/fs:483: Invalid buffer id' no longer shows up in v:errmsg.

topics.title: quicker.nvim: stale virtual text raises Invalid 'col': out of range (our PR)
topics.note: Our PR from the fix/stale-virt-text branch of charliie-dev/quicker.nvim. If the maintainer asks for changes, push them to that branch. Once merged: run tests/plugin_dependencies_spec.lua and check that the quicker error no longer shows up in v:errmsg.
